**What are you trying to do?**

Describe the actual use case, not just the feature — helps figure out if
there's already a way to do it, or a smaller change that gets you there.

**What you tried / looked at**

Worth checking the [Roadmap](../../README.md#roadmap) and [Known
limitations](../../README.md#known-limitations) first — several open items
(idle head-sway, auto-wiring transcript text into rhubarb's `-d` flag,
dedicated art for edge-case visemes) are already tracked there.

**Proposed approach (optional)**

If you have one in mind — doesn't need to be fully worked out.
